SELECT event_json FROM events INDEXED BY events_request_id_kind_idx
    WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.request_id')=?1
      AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='model_request_started'
    ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 2

SELECT event_json FROM (
    SELECT event_json,sequence FROM (
        SELECT event_json,sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_request_id_kind_idx
        WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.request_id')=?1
          AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='model_request_completed'
        ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_json,sequence FROM (
        SELECT event_json,sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_request_id_kind_idx
        WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.request_id')=?1
          AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='model_request_failed'
        ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1))
    ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1

SELECT attempt_id FROM events INDEXED BY events_message_id_kind_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.message_id')=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='assistant_message_committed' AND sequence<=?2

SELECT sequence,observation_json,observation_witness FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')=?2 AND sequence<=?3 AND sequence<?4 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence,observation_occupancy FROM events INDEXED BY events_context_reading_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')=?1 AND (json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='compaction_completed' OR COALESCE(json_type(event_json,'$.event.usage'),'null')!='null')=1 AND sequence<=?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='attempt_started' AND sequence<=?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT observation_turn_ordinal FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND conversation_id=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='attempt_started' AND sequence<=?3 ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1
SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id='selected' AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='attempt_started'

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_request_id_kind_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.request_id')=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='model_request_started' AND sequence<?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT event_id,json_extract(event_json,'$.event.message_id') FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')=?2 AND sequence<=?3 ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1

WITH adoptions AS (
         SELECT sequence,event_json FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx
         WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='inbound_turn_adopted' AND sequence<=?3
         UNION ALL
         SELECT sequence,event_json FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx
         WHERE attempt_id IS NULL AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='inbound_turn_adopted' AND sequence<?2
           AND sequence>(SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence),0) FROM events INDEXED BY events_kind_idx
             WHERE sequence<?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='attempt_started')
        )
        SELECT m.value FROM adoptions e,json_each(e.event_json,'$.event.message_ids') m
        JOIN message_ledger l ON l.message_id=m.value
        WHERE {eligible}
        ORDER BY e.sequence,CAST(m.key AS INTEGER) LIMIT 1
SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND sequence<=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='attempt_started' ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND sequence<=?2
             AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type') IN ('attempt_completed','attempt_cancelled','attempt_failed','attempt_timed_out','attempt_limit_exceeded'))

SELECT json_extract(event_json,'$.event.message_id') FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx
             WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND sequence<=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='assistant_message_committed'
             AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM observation_headers h WHERE h.reference_kind='message' AND h.reference_id=json_extract(event_json,'$.event.message_id') AND json_extract(h.header_json,'$.has_text_preview')=1)
             ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT event_json FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND sequence<=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type') IN ('turn_started','model_request_started','model_request_completed','model_request_failed','tool_execution_started','tool_execution_completed','tool_execution_failed','compaction_started','compaction_completed','assistant_message_committed','attempt_completed') ORDER BY sequence

SELECT event_json FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND sequence<=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type') IN ('assistant_message_committed','attempt_completed','attempt_cancelled','attempt_failed','attempt_timed_out','attempt_limit_exceeded') ORDER BY sequence
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='assistant_message_committed' AND sequence<?2)

SELECT sequence,event_timestamp FROM events INDEXED BY events_observation_tool_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.tool_call_id')=?1 AND attempt_id=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')=?3 AND sequence<?4 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence,event_timestamp FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='attempt_started' AND sequence<=?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT attempt_id FROM events INDEXED BY events_message_id_kind_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.message_id')=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='assistant_message_committed' AND sequence<=?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='attempt_started' AND sequence<=?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_step_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND turn_id=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='turn_started' AND sequence<=?3 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='model_request_started' AND sequence<=?2 ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_step_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND turn_id=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='model_request_started' AND sequence<=?3 ORDER BY sequence LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_request_id_kind_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.request_id')=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='model_request_started' AND sequence<?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_tool_call_scope_kind_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.tool_call_id')=?1 AND attempt_id IS ?2 AND turn_id IS ?3 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='tool_execution_started' AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.tool_id')=?4 AND sequence<?5 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_execution_id_kind_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.execution_id')=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='background_execution_committed' AND sequence<?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_subagent_id_kind_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.subagent_id')=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='subagent_ownership_committed' AND sequence<?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_workflow_coordinates_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.run_id.conversation_id')=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.run_id.attempt_id')=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.run_id.invocation')=?3 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='workflow_started' AND sequence<?4 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_interaction_id_kind_idx WHERE json_extract(event_json,'$.event.interaction_id')=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='interaction_requested' AND sequence<?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_attempt_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='turn_started' AND sequence<?2 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT sequence FROM events INDEXED BY events_step_kind_idx WHERE attempt_id=?1 AND turn_id=?2 AND json_extract(event_json,'$.event.type')='model_request_started' AND sequence<?3 ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 1
